material.acceptance_criteria: With gold below a recipe item's net price its buy button is disabled and its price tone is bad; at or above the net price it is enabled and the purchase is accepted.
material.description: Symptom: a recipe item with gold below its net price shows a gold-toned price and an enabled buy button; the purchase is then refused. Cause: scenarios/moba/panels.lua:363 sets afford true for every item with components (#def.components > 0 or ...), skipping the gold check; the tone at panels.lua:366 and the buy disable at panels.lua:372 follow it. The engine prices at def.cost minus held components and refuses below that (scenarios/moba/store.lua:108-110, reason cannot-afford). Contract broken: the shop affordability predicate must equal the purchase precondition.
material.subject: Shop enables buy on recipe items the player cannot pay for
material.witness: Recipe buy now uses the net price. Codesearch (session verify-dbc-trav-hud-lua-L2-2, dispatch 1792863244838-5123-4b1f42b18caa9bc7): the afford line is now gold >= price with price = net_price(hero, i, def) at panels.lua:358-359; net_price (line 326) mirrors store.lua acquire (cost less held components, recursive claim). CI green on head 4b24d0bc. Witness is code-level; the live shop check was not run.
material.witness_plan: Live shop check: set gold just below a recipe's net price with no components held, read the card's buy disabled state, press it and confirm the cannot-afford refusal; repeat at the net price.
